rows.en: Fear, too, is a sweetness of dazzling colors that races across the tongue.
Shut up! Don't worry about me!
Never mind me, focus on that freak! Take that freak down and snatch the ice pop!
All right! The ice pop... What happened to the ice pop!?
What the hell!? The ice pop's gone!

Man, just how bad do you want ice pop?
Where the ice pop had melted, only its stick was left, stuck in the ground.

notes.note: Quest014.bla maps TextIdOffset+N to row N+1 (checked: +3 Ankh = row 4, +4 narration = row 5, +117/+119 Ankh = rows 118/120 with 116/117/119 empty, +153 narration = row 154). Rows 79-93 = party grunt block (79-82 in quest_014); 'Kh!' reused from identical Japanese elsewhere.
Sweets Dopant (CHARA_NAME 270, +93/+94). Glossary g=f; no pronoun needed in these rows.
Leader block 97-111 (+96+pt). 103 = Zero (plain, rougher form), others share one line. Row 112 is an extra copy of the same line, not referenced by the script.
Ankh (+112/+113). 'That one' = Sweets Dopant; 'that freak' avoids a gendered pronoun. Speaking to the party: beat it and seize the ice cream.
Not referenced by Quest014.bla (+114 unused; script goes from +113 straight to GoToBattle). Speaker unknown, most likely Ankh; rendered neutrally.

Ankh (+117/+119), after the battle. Aisu rendered 'ice cream' to match the quest title/description already translated in QuestMess (system_066: 'The Ultimate Ice Cream', 'giant ice cream'); story/talk slices use 'ice pops' for Ankh's usual craving, so this quest stays on 'ice cream' for internal consistency.
Leader block 121-135 (+120+pt): 123 Momotaros, 126 Mebius (polite), 127 Zero, 128 Taro, 129 Ultraman, 130 Seven; all the identical plain-question rows share one English line.
Leader block 137-151 (+136+pt): 137 OOO teasing, 139 Momotaros, 142 Mebius (inclusive 'let's'), 150-151 Wing Zero/00 (curt, no name). Others share 'Give it up, Ankh.'

Leader block 155-169 (+154+pt; 166-169 in quest_016): 157 Momotaros and 161 Zero (rough form, same English), 160 Mebius (polite question), 162-164 Taro/Ultraman/Seven (shorter wording). Feilong Flag = item name from ItemNameFormal/QuestMess English (system_058/067/070).
